Burmese language materials are incorporated into the Mechanism evidence packages, analytical products and case files for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities.
Increased quality of analytical products and case files

target.value: Review of current collections in excess of approximately 970,000 items of potential relevance. Relevant documents identified through keyword and other strategic searches resulting in approximately 10,000 potentially relevant documents read and evaluated for relevance; significant incorporation of Burmese language materials in 9 planned analytical products and case files; and availability of Burmese language evidence translated into English for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities as part of 9 planned analytical products and case files.

actual.value: 12,000 potentially relevant documents identified, read and evaluated for relevance; significant incorporation of Burmese language materials in 36 planned analytical products and case files. In addition, approximately 2000 translations prepared.

target.value: Minimal review and incorporation of relevant materials into evidence packages, analytical products and case files.

title.narrative: 2.1. Analysis and translation of Burmese-language military documents (one consultant)

2.1. Collection of Burmese-language military documents are reviewed, analyzed and translated into English as needed for review by English-speaking analysts, investigators and lawyers and, as appropriate, incorporated into evidence packages, analytical products and case files, and made available for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities

target.value: Review of database of approximately 1 million items in the Burmese language to identify relevant material. Identification, analysis and translation (either in full or summary) of approximately 200 key military laws, regulations and other materials in the Burmese language. Preparation of at least 3 military analytical reports and review of documents for incorporation in 9 planned analytical products and case files.

actual.value: identification and review of 3,700 items in the Burmese Language to identify relevant material. Out of these 1,200 key military laws, regulations and other materials in the Burmese language were identified, analyzed and translated, as well as 2,500 telegrams, of which 320 telegrams identified and translated. the materials were incorporated in five analytical reports including one military analytical reports.

target.value: Minimal review of a small number of materials.

title.narrative: 2.2. Analysis and translation of Burmese-language official documents and arrest reports (three consultants)

2.2. Collections of Burmese-language documents and arrest reports are reviewed, analyzed and translated into English as needed for review by English-speaking analysts, investigators and lawyers and, as appropriate, incorporated into evidence packages, analytical products and case files, and made available for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities

target.value: Significant progress in the de-duplication, identification, review and analysis of a database of approximately 900,000 items. Translation (either in full or summary) of approximately 200 relevant Burmese language documents for inclusion in approximately 15 evidence packages and approximately 9 analytical products and case files.

actual.value: Identification and review of 8,800 items out of which 870 relevant Burmese language documents were translated and included in 15 analytical products.

target.value: Minimal review of a small number of materials

title.narrative: 2.2. Analysis and translation of Burmese-language official documents and arrest reports (three consultants)

2.3. The current database of 970,00 documents in Burmese language and at least 200 open source materials are reviewed, analysed selected with the most relevant material (approximately 400 items) summarized or translated into English as needed for review by English speaking analysts, investigators and lawyers and as appropriate, incorporated into evidence packages, analytical products and case files, and made available for sharing with relevant national, regional and international authorities.

target.value: Review of a database of approximately 70,000 social media items in order to identify and remove duplicates and conduct search and review for most relevant material. Translation of approximately 200 documents translated of relevant key Burmese language open source information, including pronouncements by government agencies, for inclusion in approximately 15 evidence packages and approximately 9 analytical products and case files.

actual.value: Identification and translation of 800 documents of relevant key Burmese language opensource information, including pronouncements by government agencies, for inclusion in 15 analytical products and case files.

target.value: Review of only high priority materials by one Burmese Language open-source analyst (approximately 300 documents)
